verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an API-first, hosted email service with no documented native offline mode. The only route to offline work is its IMAP/SMTP support, which lets clients like Thunderbird, Outlook or Apple Mail connect; those clients could cache mail and sync on reconnect, but the docs never say so. Its documented full-text search is a server-side API feature, so it gives no offline search. Missing for 10: any first-party offline read/search/compose capability, documented offline-sync or conflict-resolution behavior, confirmation that IMAP sync handles offline changes, and any hands-on corroboration.
